auth_environment.description: Your Younium auth environment. Use this parameter only if you want the connection to authenticate using OAuth 2.0.

auth_type.description: The authentication method you want to use for your connection.

client_id.description: Client ID of the personal access token you want to use to generate the JWT token. Use this parameter only if you want the connection to authenticate using a JWT token.

client_secret.description: Secret key of the personal access token you want to use to generate the JWT token. Use this parameter only if you want the connection to authenticate using a JWT token.

environment.description: Your Younium API environment. Use this parameter only if you want the connection to authenticate using OAuth 2.0.

jwt_environment.description: Your Younium API environment. Use this parameter only if you want the connection to authenticate using a JWT token.

password.description: Your Younium password. Use this parameter only if you want the connection to authenticate using OAuth 2.0.

username.description: Your Younium username. Use this parameter only if you want the connection to authenticate using OAuth 2.0.
